grammar_tips.title: Using the Present Simple for routines
grammar_tips.explanation: Use the present simple tense to talk about daily routines: I wake up at 7. She goes to work at 9.

explanation_translation.Hindi: दैनिक दिनचर्या के लिए Present Simple का उपयोग करें: I wake up at 7. She goes to work at 9.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 日課を話すときは現在形を使います: I wake up at 7. She goes to work at 9.

grammar_tips.title: Adding time expressions
grammar_tips.explanation: Use expressions like 'in the morning', 'at night', 'every day' to show when routines happen.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'in the morning', 'at night', 'every day' जैसे शब्दों का उपयोग करें यह दिखाने के लिए कि दिनचर्या कब होती है।
explanation_translation.Japanese: 日課の時間を表すときは「in the morning」「at night」「every day」を使います。

grammar_tips.title: Third person -s
grammar_tips.explanation: In the present simple, add -s or -es for he/she/it: He works. She watches TV.

explanation_translation.Hindi: Present Simple में he/she/it के लिए -s या -es जोड़ें: He works. She watches TV.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 現在形では三人称単数に -s または -es をつけます: He works. She watches TV.
